title: Unconditional equal-weight BTC/ETH spot-long, USD-M-perpetual-short fully funded carry (funding-harvest decay study)
mechanism: Fully funded 1:1 basis trade on BTCUSDT and ETHUSDT: hold 1 USD-M perpetual short per 1 USD of spot long (per leg), equal-weight two independent sleeves (50/50 initial capital, no cross-sleeve transfers). Portfolio signal is unconditional (always-on from 2020-08-01); within-sleeve notional is maintained equal shorter side = spot inventory. Income: the short collects positive funding and pays negative funding, settled at each 8h funding timestamp on notional marked at that instant; the trade's basis premium (spot-over-perp) is realized on rebalances/rollback rather than in the always-on window. Settle-to-market accounting: the USDT-M perpetual has no principal cash flows; hourly P&L settles into sleeve cash, sleeve equity = spot inventory mark + cash (cash may go negative as price rises, covered by the spot inventory). Development selects the variant; validation runs once frozen.

data_used.perpetual: data/raw/binance/um-perp-1h/{BTCUSDT,ETHUSDT} 1h OHLCV (open/close used), sha256-verified; per-era format drift handled: optional header rows (2022-01..2026-07 USD-M files), microsecond timestamps normalized to ms in one archive era
data_used.funding: data/raw/binance/funding-rate/{BTCUSDT,ETHUSDT} monthly exchange funding records (calc_time, funding_interval_hours, last_funding_rate); ms-jittered calc_time snapped to the canonical 8h grid (318 jittered events across both symbols; snap collisions never observed)
data_used.benchmark: data/raw/macro/nyfed_sofr_2020-01-01_2026-08-28.csv (NY Fed SOFR, percent -> fraction, daily accrual /365)
data_used.data_bounds: 2020-08-01..2024-12-31 loaded in wave one; embargoed 2025+ never read by any wave-one artifact

parameters.signal: unconditional always-on 1:1 basis carry, equal-weight BTC/ETH
parameters.variant_frozen: entry-and-hold (rebalance_hours=0): deploy once at first common tradable bar open (2020-08-01 00:00 UTC), per-side fee-adjusted notional K=0.5/(1+0.0019) per sleeve; liquidate at final bar close (2024-12-31 23:00 UTC bar)

signal_timing: Unconditional rule: no signal computation at all. Position is opened at the first tradable bar open after data availability (next-bar relative to the strategy start) and held to the final bar close; funding is received at event timestamps while held; no future bars are used anywhere (funding events are attributed only to positions already held at the event instant; entry orders at the same open fill after the snapshot).

cost_model.application: One-way taker fees incl. slippage on traded notional, charged to sleeve cash at entry (both legs), scheduled rebalance opens (delta notional, both legs), and final liquidation (both legs). Stressed run doubles all fees. Funding is never a 'cost' line: it is strategy income with exact short sign.
cost_model.entry_fee_note: Entry sized so sleeve cash is exactly zero after fees: K = sleeve_equity/(1+spot+perp fee fraction), i.e. fees reduce invested notional, not borrowed cash.

benchmark.name: SOFR cash (USD), hourly accrual of the daily simple rate
benchmark.benchmark_sharpe_note: Cash has near-zero hourly volatility, so its own Sharpe is not a meaningful ceiling (degenerate ~136); the predeclared decision statistic is the strategy's benchmark-excess Sharpe (excess net return over cash, hour by hour).

first_falsification_gate.spec: Frozen, pre-registered before validation read: the ALWAYS-ON carry mechanism must earn a positive 2024 net benchmark-excess cumulative return AND an annualized mean funding income on short notional exceed 15%/yr on the BTC/ETH pair, else the funding-harvest mechanism is judged dead for wave-one candidate purposes.
first_falsification_gate.result: PASS: excess cumulative +0.2309 (>0) and pair mean funding income ~46.4%/yr of short notional (>15%/yr).
first_falsification_gate.note: Gate deliberately tests the mechanism (funding accrual), not the Sharpe; Sharpe/cash-benchmark logic is in the main criteria.

leakage_checks: No embargoed bars read: run.py fails closed when --end > 2024-12-31 unless QUANT_HOLDOUT_UNLOCK=1 (external evaluator only); wave-one artifacts generated with the flag never set; verified by gate test (exit 2).

Position logic uses next-bar execution: entries/rebalances fill at bar opens of bars >= signal bar; funding credited only to positions held at the event instant (entry orders at that same open fill after the snapshot); boundary settlements use previous closes only.
Funding attribution window (event hour index) computed from event timestamps < next bar boundaries; no rate is applied before it is charged in reality (calc_time is the settlement instant).
Microsecond timestamp era normalized to ms; missing spot hours (10 audited outages, all 2020-2023, none 2024) forward-filled for MARKING ONLY and no trade is simulated on an untradeable bar.

Development metrics were computed on 2020-08-01..2023-12-31 only for variant selection; the validation slice was read once for the frozen variant and once to verify identity invariants (same frozen parameters).

The variant grid (rebalance {0,24,168,720}h) was fixed before any 2024 metric was read; dev-window selection chose rebalance_hours=0 (highest dev 2x-cost excess: 2.573 vs 0.205/0.275/0.367); no post-hoc parameter changes.
No timing or universe search: universe fixed by task (BTCUSDT+ETHUSDT), signal unconditional by task.
risks: Monotone full-2024 carry Sharpe ~10 is an artifact of a low-vol fully hedged position in a year of high positive funding; not comparable to directional Sharpe numbers and unlikely to persist if funding normalizes (BTC ann. funding premium was ~45%/yr of notional in 2024 vs ~9%/yr in 2020).
Cash benchmark is crude: no interbank spread/priority, SOFR published solo rate with same-day T+0 read; using an 'effective fed funds' curve would move the benchmark $ by <5 bps/yr.
Fee assumption: taker + slippage at 12/7 bps is conservative for small notional but underestimates slippage risks at scale; 2x stress kept excess cumulative positive (+0.226).

Funding attribution: USDT-M funding is charged on margin notional at the event instant; if the actual venue charges on mark price at a different instant (e.g., mid-hour), realized funding would differ slightly; NOT modeled.

Cross-collateralization: sleeve cash may go deeply negative in the settled accounting (2024 mean -$1.27 per BTC sleeve per $0.5 initial); a marginaling venue would charge financing on that negative balance; this assumes the spot inventory fully collateralizes it (typical portfolio-margin treatment).
No interest paid on idle sleeve cash and no interest earned on spot inventory value growth; both are second-order (<10 bps/yr).
Funding timestamps have ms jitter (snapped); potential venue-specific conventions (e.g., cap/floor on funding rates at extreme premium) not modeled but rare (0 events hit caps in-sample).

Wave-one candidate pool: only 4 variants were tried; richer carry structures (dynamic sleeve sizing, funding-threshold gating) were not explored per the task's bounded-scope directive; the selected variant may be a suboptimal representative of the family.
next_experiment: Historical-confirmation-family internal selection (protocol-amendment.json candidate_groups carry_complex): run the frozen rebalance_hours=0 always-on carry on the embargoed 2025-01-01..2026-07-31 window with the exact frozen parameters from this strategy.json, to quantify funding normalization decay; then register the prospective forward shadow. Secondary (wave-two, same family): funding-threshold gate variants, maximum +2 variants on the family; dynamic sleeve weights that relax the equal-weight constraint only if data supports it without maximizing one-off Sharpe.

holdout_envelope.run_py_gate: run.py refuses --end > 2024-12-31 without QUANT_HOLDOUT_UNLOCK=1 (verified exit code 2)
holdout_envelope.returns_csv_content: frozen selected validation series (daily agg of the 2024-01-01..2024-12-31 net strategy vs SOFR cash benchmark)
holdout_envelope.notes: No post-2024 data was read for any selection, metric, or gate decision in wave one.

protocol_amendment_ack: 2025-2026 is historical_confirmation (parameter-embargoed, not epistemically blind) per explorations/protocol-amendment.json; family-level selection will pick at most 1 carry_complex member by 2x-cost validation excess Sharpe; the genuine untouched evidence starts with the prospective forward shadow from 2026-08-29.
